measurement: evidence retrieval recall on data/bench_internal/long_context.jsonl (1548 questions with annotated gold evidence)
metric: share of questions whose gold evidence sentences survive into the evidence block handed to the encoder
conclusion: Lexical retrieval, not the decision head, is the dominant long-context failure: above 1k tokens the decisive sentence survives in under 10% of cases at a 140-word budget. Recall scales with the budget (0.28 -> 0.44 -> 0.57 at 140/300/600 words) but not to a usable level, so a learned retriever (or hierarchical chunk scoring) is required. Per-candidate quotas do not help at a small budget because the reserved slots are spent on decoy paragraphs that name the wrong options.
